source.title: How to Dress Like Tom Ford

tips.text: Wide lapels and a structured, padded shoulder give a suit a strong, sharp silhouette, especially on a tall slim frame.
A black suit is traditionally evening wear; for daytime most men look better in navy or grey.
tips.why: Black is harsh in daylight and unflattering on many.

tips.text: With a black suit, wear black shoes: plain oxfords, derbies or sleek chelsea boots.
tips.why: Brown breaks the sharp monochrome look.

tips.text: A crisp white shirt gives the strongest contrast with a dark suit.
tips.why: High contrast looks sharp and clean.

tips.text: French cuffs with cufflinks are one of the few pieces of jewellery a classic dresser can wear.
tips.why: They add detail without looking flashy.

tips.text: Leaving a shirt open three buttons deep is a fashion-world look; in normal settings one or two open buttons is enough.
tips.why: Too much chest looks out of place at work.

tips.text: Skip sneakers with tailoring; leather shoes or boots keep a suit looking strong.
tips.why: Trainers weaken the look of a suit.

tips.text: Tie the tie with a dimple under the knot; a black knit or silk tie keeps a monochrome outfit coherent.
A white pocket square in a simple straight fold is the most understated choice and goes with everything.
tips.why: A glimpse of white looks elegant.

tips.text: A good watch should be discovered rather than announced, and should suit the rest of the outfit.
For a rugged casual look, pair slim dark jeans and brown leather boots with a denim shirt and a suede trucker jacket.
tips.why: Rugged textures and earth tones dress down well.

tips.text: When a dress code says black tie, follow it properly; a midnight navy dinner suit is a valid alternative to black.
tips.why: Respecting the dress code is part of dressing well.

tips.text: Match the size of a bow tie to the width of your lapels.
A personal uniform works for a public figure, but most men are better served by a variety of outfits for different occasions and moods.
tips.why: Real life needs different clothes for different situations.

tips.text: Breaking rules works only when you know them; whatever you wear, put deliberate thought into it.
tips.why: Intent is what makes an outfit look stylish.

outfits.why: Black suit, white shirt, black tie and black shoes: a strong evening monochrome.
